title: Retire unused legacy chattic resources after an observation period
description:
Checklist, only after an observation period with no traffic and with the owner's approval:
- [ ] legacy marketing distribution E2KIMGDJ4DW3XZ (aliases already removed)
- [ ] legacy ChatticusMarketing stack (drifted)
- [ ] Python Function URL and its WAITLIST and CONTACT items (confirm the 2 items were migrated)
- [ ] ChatticusThinTurn* stacks
- [ ] ChatticusDns zone

Feature: Legacy retirement
  Scenario: Resources removed
    Given the observation period passed with no use
    When each item is deleted in turn
    Then the live sites keep serving

comments.author: home
comments.text: Final inventory facts 2026-10-19 (nothing deleted yet): the legacy marketing distribution E2KIMGDJ4DW3XZ has no aliases; the Python intake Function URL and its two data items remain; the old stacks remain. Development now runs in the production AWS account, and the old chatticus-development account has been wiped of Chatticus resources (only CDK bootstrap remains).

comments.author: home
comments.text: Legacy retirement run 2026-10-25. DELETED (DELETE_COMPLETE): ChatticusAuthStaging, ChatticusAuthProduction, ChatticusThinTurnStaging. Gates held: no DNS pointing at them (auth/auth-staging delegated to chatticus-production zones; legacy chattic.us zone is not the delegated one), no traffic in 14 days (staging front door last used 2026-09-26), no importers, user pools empty. Staging messaging table (62 items) backed up first as on-demand backup chatticus-legacy-retire-staging-messaging-20261025 (legacy account); table, both queues, both user pools and the staging InvokeKey were Retain and still exist. Secrets scheduled for deletion (30 day window, ends 2026-11-24): InvokeKey581783BE-P6oUHWIsZvY0, chatticus/staging/oauth/google, chatticus/production/oauth/google. SKIPPED: ChatticusWeb and ChatticusAuth (management zone still has live dev.chattic.us and auth-dev.chattic.us records pointing at them), ChatticusThinTurn (imported by ChatticusWeb, front door invoked 2026-10-20), ChatticusThinTurnProduction (front door last invoked 2026-10-15, inside the 14-day window; eligible after 2026-10-29; 97 item table needs backup first), ChatticusMarketing and distribution E2KIMGDJ4DW3XZ (requests on 2026-10-20 and 2026-10-23; stack in use as ChatticusDns importer). Not examined: Python Function URL and WAITLIST/CONTACT items, ChatticusDns zone (hosted zones out of scope). Remaining secrets (dev/production InvokeKey, OperatorKey, dev oauth/google) are still referenced by surviving stacks. chattic.us and hey.chattic.us returned 200 after each deletion. Restore: aws dynamodb restore-table-from-backup --profile legacy --target-table-name <new> --backup-arn <arn of the named backup>; aws secretsmanager restore-secret --secret-id <name> within 30 days.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Legacy retirement run 2026-10-26 (owner approved handling the two legacy dev DNS records). DNS: the delegated chattic.us zone lives in the management account; its dev.chattic.us and auth-dev.chattic.us records (A and AAAA each, four record sets) were backed up with the full zone to chatticus-local/ route53-management-chattic-us-backup-20261026.json and then deleted; nothing else touched. Copies of the same names in the undelegated ChatticusDns zone were stack-managed and vanished with their stacks. DELETED (DELETE_COMPLETE, one at a time): ChatticusWeb, then ChatticusAuth (dev Cognito pool had 5 users; list saved to chatticus-local/ legacy-dev-userpool-users-20261026.json; no exports or importers). chattic.us, hey.chattic.us, develop.chattic.us and staging.chattic.us returned 200 before and after each deletion. Secret chatticus/development/oauth/google scheduled for deletion (30 day window, ends 2026-11-25); no remaining stack references it. SKIPPED: ChatticusThinTurn. Its 106 front-door invocations came from a single internet scanner IP probing paths like /admin, /.env and metadata-service proxies, all answered 404; they are not ours and not real use, but the rule was to skip when not provably ours, so the stack remains (messaging table not yet backed up). Owner can confirm deletion of ChatticusThinTurn (and its dev InvokeKey and OperatorKey secrets) after back-up. Still pending: ChatticusThinTurnProduction (eligible after 2026-10-29), ChatticusMarketing and its distribution, Python intake, ChatticusDns zone. Restore: DNS via aws route53 change-resource-record-sets CREATE using the records_to_delete array in the backup file; secret via aws secretsmanager restore-secret within the window.

comments.author: home
comments.text: ChatticusThinTurn (legacy dev) deleted 2026-10-26 after the coordinator accepted the traffic finding (106 requests from one scanner address, all 404). Before deletion the messaging table (5185 items) was backed up on demand as chatticus-legacy-retire-dev-messaging-20261026, status AVAILABLE, in the legacy account. No stack imported its exports. The stack's DeletionPolicy was Delete, so the table, both queues and the dev InvokeKey and OperatorKey secrets went with it (nothing retained, unlike the staging stack); nothing was left to schedule. Live sites returned 200 before and after. Restore: aws dynamodb restore-table-from-backup --profile legacy --target-table-name NEW_NAME --backup-arn ARN_OF_THE_NAMED_BACKUP. Remaining legacy Chatticus stacks: ThinTurnProduction (eligible after 2026-10-29), Marketing and its distribution, Dns, Computers, Snapshots, Budgets, GitHubDeploy.

right_now_summary: Legacy Chattic resources await a no-traffic observation period and owner approval before removal.
